name: Doing Gods Will
overview: Scripture reveals that doing God's will involves wholehearted obedience to His commandments and trusting Him fully rather than relying on human understanding, as seen in Deuteronomy 28:1 and Proverbs 3:5. God's will is perfect, good, and acceptable, and can be discerned through the transformation and renewal of the mind (Romans 12:2). Jesus emphasizes that true entry into the kingdom of heaven depends on doing the will of the Father, not merely professing faith (Matthew 7:21), while Jeremiah 29:11 assures believers that God's plans are for their peace and hope. Ultimately, doing God's will aligns with the prayer that His kingdom come and His will be done on earth as in heaven (Matthew 6:10).
